            result[h + r][w + c] = grid[r][c]
            
            # Frame should extend with proper alignment
            if c == w - 1 or r == h - 1:
                result[r][c] = frame_color
                result[r][w + c] = frame_color
                result[h + r][c] = frame_color
                result[h + r][w + c] = frame_color
    
    return result
